relationships.subject: Klotho
relationships.evidence_quote: the suppression of angiogenesis and extracellular matrix catabolism was related to inhibition of the Ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1 (Rac1)/PAK1 axis and matrix metalloproteinase 2 protein expression by exogenous Klotho

relationships.subject: Klotho
relationships.evidence_quote: The results indicated that 400 pM exogenous Klotho significantly ameliorated extracellular matrix degradation and angiogenesis.

key_findings: Exogenous Klotho (400 pM) reduced ECM degradation and angiogenesis in nucleus pulposus cells.
Effect linked to inhibition of the Rac1/PAK1 axis and MMP-2 expression.
